sources.title: Pre-Crash Scenario Typology for Crash Avoidance Research
sources.scope: Rear-end, road-departure, lane-change, crossing-path, opposite-direction, backing, pedestrian, pedalcyclist, animal, and object pre-crash groups.

sources.title: Statistics of Light-Vehicle Pre-Crash Scenarios Based on 2011–2015 National Crash Data
sources.scope: Thirty-six nationally grounded light-vehicle pre-crash scenarios and their road, environment, and avoidance characteristics.

sources.title: Description of Light-Vehicle Pre-Crash Scenarios for Safety Applications Based on Vehicle-to-Vehicle Communications
sources.scope: Five-second pre-crash speed, braking, and deceleration kinematics for priority vehicle-to-vehicle conflicts.

sources.title: AEB Pedestrian test scenarios
sources.scope: Adult and child crossing, parked-car occlusion, longitudinal pedestrian, turning pedestrian, reversing, daylight, and low-light cases.

incidents.title: Unprotected left across opposing through vehicle
incidents.summary: A turning vehicle accepts a narrowing gap across an oncoming through path.

actors.intent: Proceed legally while retaining a physically plausible avoidance opportunity.
Maintain through movement into the shared conflict zone.

eventSequence: Ego approaches the junction.
Ego initiates an unprotected left.
Opposing vehicle reaches the conflict zone inside the critical gap.

incidents.title: Cross traffic rolls through a stop-controlled approach
incidents.summary: A cross-traffic vehicle fails to yield and enters as ego traverses the junction.

actors.intent: Proceed legally while retaining a physically plausible avoidance opportunity.
Enter from the crossing arm without completing the required stop.

eventSequence: Ego enters with priority.
Cross traffic rolls past its control point.
Paths overlap in the junction conflict zone.

incidents.title: Late red-light entry against released traffic
incidents.summary: One vehicle enters at the end of its phase after the conflicting movement has started.

actors.intent: Proceed legally while retaining a physically plausible avoidance opportunity.
Continue into the junction after the permissive phase ends.

eventSequence: Conflicting phase releases ego.
Late vehicle crosses its stop line.
Both movements occupy the conflict zone.

incidents.title: Right turn across an occupied crosswalk
incidents.summary: A turning vehicle must yield to a pedestrian already entering the receiving-road crosswalk.

actors.intent: Proceed legally while retaining a physically plausible avoidance opportunity.
Cross at a steady walking pace with priority.

eventSequence: Pedestrian enters the crosswalk.
Ego begins the right turn.
Ego path crosses the pedestrian trajectory.

incidents.title: Left turn across a far-side pedestrian crossing
incidents.summary: Ego focuses on opposing traffic and encounters a pedestrian in the far-side crosswalk.

actors.intent: Proceed legally while retaining a physically plausible avoidance opportunity.
Cross the receiving road while ego completes its turn.

eventSequence: Ego waits for opposing traffic.
Pedestrian enters the far crosswalk.
Ego accelerates into the pedestrian path.

incidents.title: Opposing turn encroaches into ego lane
incidents.summary: An opposing vehicle cuts the turn and partially occupies ego’s receiving lane.

actors.intent: Proceed legally while retaining a physically plausible avoidance opportunity.
Take an apex that crosses the lane boundary.

eventSequence: Both vehicles approach.
Other vehicle turns with excessive path cut.
Ego must brake or move laterally to preserve clearance.

incidents.title: Blocked junction hides crossing traffic
incidents.summary: A queued vehicle masks cross traffic until ego noses into an obstructed junction.

actors.intent: Proceed legally while retaining a physically plausible avoidance opportunity.
Remain stopped and block the sight line.
Traverse behind the queue at legal speed.

eventSequence: Queue stops near the junction.
Ego creeps past the occluder.
Cross traffic is revealed at short range.

incidents.title: Child darts from between parked vehicles
incidents.summary: A child emerges laterally from complete vehicle occlusion into ego’s lane.

actors.intent: Proceed legally while retaining a physically plausible avoidance opportunity.
Run from the curb gap into the travel lane.
Remain static and fully mask the child before reveal.

eventSequence: Child waits behind parked vehicles.
Ego approaches with no line of sight.
Child runs into the lane at the reveal threshold.

incidents.title: Adult crosses at an unmarked midblock location
incidents.summary: An adult walks across a corridor away from a controlled crossing.

actors.intent: Proceed legally while retaining a physically plausible avoidance opportunity.
Walk continuously from curb to curb.

eventSequence: Pedestrian approaches the curb.
Pedestrian commits to the crossing.
Ego reaches the shared lane segment.

incidents.title: Stopped vehicle masks a pedestrian in the next lane
incidents.summary: One vehicle yields at a crossing while an adjacent-lane ego cannot initially see the pedestrian.

actors.intent: Proceed legally while retaining a physically plausible avoidance opportunity.
Stop before the crosswalk and create an occlusion.
Continue across the hidden adjacent lane.

eventSequence: Lead vehicle yields.
Ego approaches in the adjacent lane.
Pedestrian emerges from behind the stopped vehicle.

incidents.title: Reversing vehicle crosses a pedestrian path
incidents.summary: A vehicle backs from a parking position while a pedestrian passes behind it.

actors.intent: Proceed legally while retaining a physically plausible avoidance opportunity.
Walk behind the reversing path without an abrupt change of pace.

eventSequence: Pedestrian enters the rear blind zone.
Ego begins reversing.
Rear path and walking path overlap.

incidents.title: Right hook across a parallel cyclist
incidents.summary: A right-turning vehicle crosses a cyclist continuing straight on its right.

actors.intent: Proceed legally while retaining a physically plausible avoidance opportunity.
Continue straight alongside ego at cycling speed.

eventSequence: Cyclist and ego travel parallel.
Ego begins a right turn.
Cyclist enters the turning path.

incidents.title: Cyclist crosses the vehicle path
incidents.summary: A cyclist enters from a side path or crossing with a short lateral arrival gap.

actors.intent: Proceed legally while retaining a physically plausible avoidance opportunity.
Ride across the vehicle path without stopping in-lane.

eventSequence: Ego approaches steadily.
Cyclist enters from the side.
Trajectories coincide at the conflict point.

incidents.title: Parked-car door opens into cyclist path
incidents.summary: A parked occupant opens a door as a cyclist passes in the door zone.

actors.intent: Proceed legally while retaining a physically plausible avoidance opportunity.
Ride parallel through the door zone.
Swing from closed to open after the cyclist commits.

eventSequence: Cyclist approaches the parked row.
Door begins opening.
Cyclist must brake or merge around the door.

incidents.title: Lead vehicle brakes sharply in flowing traffic
incidents.summary: A lead vehicle performs a plausible emergency stop from cruising speed.

actors.intent: Proceed legally while retaining a physically plausible avoidance opportunity.
Brake hard but within dry-road passenger-car capability.

eventSequence: Vehicles travel at a stable headway.
Lead vehicle brakes abruptly.
Ego must respond before minimum separation is exhausted.

incidents.title: Stopped queue tail beyond a sight restriction
incidents.summary: Ego encounters the end of a stopped queue with limited preview distance.

actors.intent: Proceed legally while retaining a physically plausible avoidance opportunity.
Remain stopped in lane.
Remain stopped ahead to establish a credible queue.

eventSequence: Queue forms downstream.
Ego enters the constrained sight segment.
Stopped tail becomes visible within the braking envelope.

incidents.title: Lead vehicle cuts out and reveals a stopped vehicle
incidents.summary: A lead vehicle changes lanes late, exposing a stationary obstruction directly ahead.

actors.intent: Proceed legally while retaining a physically plausible avoidance opportunity.
Change lanes late while preserving clearance.
Remain stationary in ego lane.

eventSequence: Ego follows the lead vehicle.
Lead moves aside near the obstruction.
Stopped vehicle is revealed at a short but nonzero stopping margin.

incidents.title: Close cut-in followed by braking
incidents.summary: Another vehicle enters ego’s lane at low headway and immediately decelerates.

actors.intent: Proceed legally while retaining a physically plausible avoidance opportunity.
Merge into the accepted gap, then brake for downstream traffic.

eventSequence: Vehicles travel in adjacent lanes.
Other vehicle merges ahead of ego.
Other vehicle brakes before headway recovers.

incidents.title: Slow cyclist or mobility user ahead
incidents.summary: Ego closes on a much slower vulnerable road user sharing the lane.

actors.intent: Proceed legally while retaining a physically plausible avoidance opportunity.
Proceed steadily near the lane edge with small natural lateral variation.

eventSequence: Ego enters behind the slower user.
Closing gap becomes apparent.
Oncoming or adjacent traffic constrains passing.

incidents.title: Adjacent vehicle drifts into occupied lane
incidents.summary: A parallel vehicle crosses the lane boundary while ego occupies its blind spot.

actors.intent: Proceed legally while retaining a physically plausible avoidance opportunity.
Move laterally into ego lane without adequate clearance.

eventSequence: Vehicles run parallel.
Other vehicle begins an unsignalled drift.
Side envelopes overlap unless ego yields.

incidents.title: Merge gap collapses under acceleration
incidents.summary: A merging vehicle and ego both accelerate toward the same diminishing gap.

actors.intent: Proceed legally while retaining a physically plausible avoidance opportunity.
Accelerate from the entry lane toward ego’s gap.

eventSequence: Merging path converges.
Both vehicles increase speed.
Accepted gap falls below safe headway.

incidents.title: Late merge at a lane drop
incidents.summary: A vehicle reaches the end of a disappearing lane and forces entry into ego’s lane.

actors.intent: Proceed legally while retaining a physically plausible avoidance opportunity.
Continue to the taper and merge with limited remaining pavement.

eventSequence: Lane begins narrowing.
Late merger stays alongside ego.
Vehicle crosses the boundary near the lane end.

incidents.title: Oncoming vehicle overtakes into ego lane
incidents.summary: An opposing vehicle uses ego’s lane to pass and must return before closing distance expires.

actors.intent: Proceed legally while retaining a physically plausible avoidance opportunity.
Pass a slow vehicle by entering the opposing lane.
Maintain a steady low speed.

eventSequence: Overtaker moves across centerline.
Ego appears in the opposing path.
Overtaker attempts to return behind or ahead of the slow vehicle.

incidents.title: Parked vehicle pulls into the travel lane
incidents.summary: A parked vehicle begins moving from curb or bay into ego’s lane.

actors.intent: Proceed legally while retaining a physically plausible avoidance opportunity.
Pull out with initially restricted visibility.

eventSequence: Vehicle waits in the parking position.
Front end enters the travel lane.
Ego arrives before the vehicle completes its merge.

incidents.title: Vehicle backs from an angled space into traffic
incidents.summary: A reversing vehicle emerges from a bay with limited sight of approaching traffic.

actors.intent: Proceed legally while retaining a physically plausible avoidance opportunity.
Reverse from the bay across the travel aisle.

eventSequence: Ego approaches the parking aisle.
Other vehicle begins reversing.
Its rear crosses into ego’s path.

incidents.title: Double-parked delivery vehicle forces a merge
incidents.summary: A stopped delivery vehicle blocks the lane and hides activity near the curb.

actors.intent: Proceed legally while retaining a physically plausible avoidance opportunity.
Remain stopped partially in lane.
Move between curb and vehicle while occluded.

eventSequence: Delivery vehicle blocks part of lane.
Ego begins passing.
Worker or oncoming traffic constrains the pass.

incidents.title: Vehicle emerges from a driveway or access point
incidents.summary: A vehicle crosses sidewalk and enters the road from a visually constrained access.

actors.intent: Proceed legally while retaining a physically plausible avoidance opportunity.
Creep from access, then accelerate into traffic.

eventSequence: Ego approaches the frontage.
Other vehicle noses past the sight obstruction.
Other vehicle enters the travel lane.

incidents.title: Pedestrian emerges from behind a stopped bus
incidents.summary: A bus masks a pedestrian who enters the roadway near the stop.

actors.intent: Proceed legally while retaining a physically plausible avoidance opportunity.
Remain at the stop and create the primary occlusion.
Cross from the hidden side of the bus.

eventSequence: Bus stops for passengers.
Ego approaches the bus.
Pedestrian emerges beyond the bus body.

incidents.title: Bus pulls from stop into occupied lane
incidents.summary: A bus re-enters traffic while ego is approaching alongside.

actors.intent: Proceed legally while retaining a physically plausible avoidance opportunity.
Depart the stop and merge progressively into the lane.

eventSequence: Bus signals departure.
Ego reaches the rear quarter.
Bus crosses the lane boundary.

incidents.title: School-zone child dart-out at pickup time
incidents.summary: A child runs from a pickup queue or curb activity into the travel lane.

actors.intent: Proceed legally while retaining a physically plausible avoidance opportunity.
Run toward the school frontage across the lane.
Remain stopped and occlude the child.

eventSequence: Pickup queue creates visual clutter.
Child separates from the curb group.
Child enters ego’s lane.

incidents.title: Vehicle encounters a late school crossing release
incidents.summary: A crossing group starts while an approaching vehicle is near the school crossing.

actors.intent: Proceed legally while retaining a physically plausible avoidance opportunity.
Enter first and hold the crossing.
Follow across with varied but bounded spacing.

eventSequence: Guard approaches the crossing.
Guard enters and signals traffic to stop.
Children occupy the crossing behind the guard.

incidents.title: Temporary work-zone lane shift with a stopped queue
incidents.summary: Channelizing devices shift traffic laterally toward a short queue or worker area.

actors.intent: Proceed legally while retaining a physically plausible avoidance opportunity.
Stop inside the shifted alignment.
Define a narrowing, traversable temporary path.

eventSequence: Cones progressively close part of the lane.
Ego enters the shifted path.
A queue tail appears near the taper exit.

incidents.title: Worker steps outside the protected work area
incidents.summary: A worker briefly enters the open lane from behind equipment or barriers.

actors.intent: Proceed legally while retaining a physically plausible avoidance opportunity.
Step into the lane while attending to the work task.
Remain static and partially occlude the worker.

eventSequence: Ego approaches a marked work activity.
Worker moves past the occluder.
Worker occupies the lane edge or lane.

incidents.title: Loss of control on a curve
incidents.summary: Ego enters a bend too quickly for the available surface condition and drifts toward the edge.

actors.intent: Proceed legally while retaining a physically plausible avoidance opportunity.
Define the non-traversable edge and recovery boundary.

eventSequence: Ego approaches the curve.
Required lateral acceleration exceeds the chosen margin.
Vehicle departs the intended lane unless speed is reduced.

incidents.title: Fallen cargo blocks part of the lane
incidents.summary: A nonmoving object becomes visible late enough to require controlled braking or avoidance.

actors.intent: Proceed legally while retaining a physically plausible avoidance opportunity.
Remain stationary and physically occupy a bounded lane region.

eventSequence: Cargo rests ahead.
Sight line reveals the object.
Ego brakes or avoids while retaining road boundaries.

incidents.title: Animal runs into the roadway
incidents.summary: An animal crosses rapidly from the roadside with limited warning.

actors.intent: Proceed legally while retaining a physically plausible avoidance opportunity.
Traverse the lane at a bounded running speed.

eventSequence: Ego cruises through the segment.
Animal appears from the roadside.
Animal crosses the projected ego path.

incidents.title: Disabled vehicle occupies a live lane
incidents.summary: A stationary disabled vehicle constrains the lane near a sight restriction.

actors.intent: Proceed legally while retaining a physically plausible avoidance opportunity.
Remain stationary with a plausible roadside orientation.
Stay near the vehicle but outside ego’s nominal path.

eventSequence: Disabled vehicle is stationary.
Ego receives limited preview.
Ego must stop or pass with safe occupant clearance.

variants.title: Low-angle dawn glare
variants.visibility: directional glare with otherwise clear air
